security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Grab any video or sound, card-table style.
bundle.longDescription: Balader downloads video and audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, SoundCloud and 1800+ other sites. Pick a quality card, play it, keep the file.
bundle.copyright: MIT licensed. yt-dlp (Unlicense), FFmpeg (GPL builds) and Deno (MIT) are fetched at first run.
